svg.title: Figure 3-17a. System FMEA failure modes: lateral and longitudinal control
svg.desc: Figure 3-17a: 14 System FMEA failure modes, lateral and longitudinal control. SFM-001 Steering torque applied when not engaged (S 10; H-01). Effects: Torque request sent to EPS outside an active state / Unexpected steering wheel motion and lateral deviation / Driver surprised during manual driving; possible lane departure. Causes: SFM-001.C1 State machine reports active while disabled (O 6, D 8, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-001.C2 Panda allows steering TX without valid engagement (controls_allowed set incorrectly) (O 5, D 3, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-001.C3 Steering message packed with non-zero torque/request bit while latActive is false (O 4, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-012 open, SFM-ACT-013 open. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.15. SFM-002 Steering torque or torque rate above limits (S 10; H-01). Effects: Torque request exceeds the limits in SAFETY.md / ISO 11270 / Lateral deviation faster than a driver can correct (> 1 m in 0.9 s) / Lane departure or collision with adjacent traffic or roadside. Causes: SFM-002.C1 Lateral controller output too high (gain, torque model, saturation logic) (O 7, D 10, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-002.C2 Model outputs excessive desired curvature (O 7, D 10, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-002.C3 Safety model torque/rate limits wrong for this vehicle or not enforced (O 6, D 9, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-002.C4 Wrong vehicle parameters (steer ratio, lateral accel factor, torque offsets) from online learners (O 5, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-002.C5 The EPS misreports its motor torque, so the panda's measured-torque tracking check is misled; the magnitude and rate limits still apply (WP-A-03 DFI-11) (O 3, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-001 open, SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-009 open, SFM-ACT-010 in_progress, SFM-ACT-012 open, SFM-ACT-019 open. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.01 (single point), BE-1.02, BE-1.03. SFM-003 Steering in the wrong direction (away from lane center) (S 10; H-01). Effects: Torque request sign opposite to the required correction / Vehicle steers toward lane boundary / Lane departure into oncoming/adjacent traffic or off road. Causes: SFM-003.C1 Calibration (camera extrinsics) wrong or not converged (O 5, D 8, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-003.C2 Sign convention error in steering signal parse or pack for this car (O 6, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-003.C3 Model desired curvature has wrong sign (corrupted frame, wrong camera stream) (O 6, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-003.C4 Device mount moved after calibration (O 5, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-009 open, SFM-ACT-014 open. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.02, BE-1.03. SFM-004 Insufficient lateral control (undershoot in curves, drift toward lane edge) (S 10; H-02). Effects: Achieved curvature below desired curvature / Vehicle drifts to lane edge in curves / Lane departure if the driver does not intervene. Causes: SFM-004.C1 Safety model torque limit below what the curve requires (by design) (O 6, D 10, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-004.C2 EPS limits or rejects torque request (EPS fault, torque limit, lockout) (O 5, D 10, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-004.C3 Controller tuning or torque model too weak for vehicle state (O 6, D 8, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-001 open, SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-017 completed, SFM-ACT-021 open. Fault trees: SG-02 BE-2.01, BE-2.23. SFM-005 Loss of lateral control without driver alert (S 10; H-02). Effects: Steering requests stop or are ignored while the item shows engaged / Vehicle no longer follows the lane / Driver unaware of loss; lane departure. Causes: SFM-005.C1 EPS stops accepting requests without a fault signal on CAN (O 3, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-005.C2 pandad stops forwarding TX without the state being reported (O 5, D 10, M 6, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-005.C3 Process crash or hang not detected by liveness checks (O 6, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-005.C4 A non-finite controller input (desired curvature, roll) zeroes the lateral output without an event while the item shows engaged (controlsd.py:122-131; TSR-604 met in part, GAP-19) (O 5, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-012 open, SFM-ACT-018 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-02 UE-2.19, BE-2.05, BE-2.06; SG-06 BE-2.05, BE-2.06. SFM-006 Lateral command frozen at last value (S 10; H-01). Effects: Same torque request repeated regardless of road geometry / Vehicle holds a constant steering input / Vehicle leaves the lane on a curve or straight. Causes: SFM-006.C1 controlsd hangs while card keeps sending the last carControl (O 6, D 10, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-006.C2 modeld output frozen (stale frame) but still published as valid (O 4, D 10, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-006.C3 Messaging delivers stale data with fresh timestamps (O 5, D 10, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-015 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.19, G1.3; SG-03 BE-1.19. SFM-007 Oscillating lateral control (S 7; no hazard). Effects: Torque request oscillates / Vehicle weaves within the lane / Driver discomfort; possible over-correction by driver. Causes: SFM-007.C1 Controller instability (gain, delay compensation, lagd estimate) (O 7, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-007.C2 Control loop timing jitter (CPU load, thermal throttling) (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open. Fault trees: none. SFM-038 Warning of a lateral-control fault or limit late, not escalated or missing (S 10; H-02). Effects: steerTempUnavailable not escalated to a take-over request, steerSaturated raised late or not at all, or the panda's EPS-fault flag not acted on / Driver not prompted to take over while lateral control is lost or limited / Driver unaware of the loss or limit; lane departure. Causes: SFM-038.C1 The lighter EPS-fault prompt (steerTempUnavailableSilent, a LOW-priority WARNING with a chime and no soft disable, events.py:516-521) after a recent override, at standstill or while the driver steers is not limited to 1.5 s, so a long fault does not escalate to the take-over request (car_events.py:167-185, STEER_FAULT_SILENT_FRAMES; T-25, GAP-03). Until BL-005 the prompt was latched for the whole fault by design; from BL-006 the cause is a defect of the TSR-607 (b)/(c) frame counter (O 5, D 4, M -, AP H); SFM-038.C2 pandad publishes the panda fields epsFault and requestsRejected (pandad.cc:137-138), but no SoC process reads them (txRateExceeded is read, TSR-615), so a panda-side EPS-fault refusal reaches the driver only through the panda siren and the stock EPS path (SW FMEA SWF-025 notes) (O 8, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-038.C3 steerSaturated needs the controller saturated, a desired lateral acceleration above 1.0 m/s², an undershoot above 1.2x and no steering input for 2 s (selfdrived.py:470-484), and the controller reports saturation only after 0.4 s (latcontrol.py, T-30); a gradual deficit therefore warns late or not at all (WP-S-04 §3.8.1) (O 8, D 8, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-021 open, SFM-ACT-023 completed, SFM-ACT-024 open. Fault trees: SG-02 BE-2.08, BE-2.24. SFM-008 Unintended acceleration (S 10; H-03). Effects: Positive acceleration requested when not required or not engaged / Vehicle accelerates unexpectedly / Rear-end collision with lead vehicle or loss of control. Causes: SFM-008.C1 Planner targets higher speed (missed lead, wrong set speed) (O 7, D 9, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-008.C2 Longitudinal controller output too high (O 7, D 10, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-008.C3 Wrong scaling of acceleration request for this car (O 4, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-008.C4 Powertrain applies more acceleration than requested (O 3, D 10, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-001 open, SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-012 open. Fault trees: SG-03 BE-3.02, BE-3.06, BE-3.13. SFM-009 Unintended or excessive deceleration (phantom braking) (S 10; H-04). Effects: Strong deceleration requested without a real obstacle / Vehicle brakes hard / Rear-end collision by following vehicle; occupant injury. Causes: SFM-009.C1 False lead (radar ghost, model false positive) or FCW false trigger (O 7, D 8, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-009.C2 Longitudinal controller overshoot (O 7, D 10, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-009.C3 Wrong vEgo/aEgo from CAN parse (O 6, D 9, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-009.C4 Defect in the announcement of the driver-monitoring no-response stop (TSR-624, #374, BL-007): noResponseDecelIn or the countdown alert ("Car Stops in N s", then "Car Is Stopping") wrong or missing, so the stop starts without the at-least-1 s announcement. Up to BL-006 the cause was by design (no lead time). The fault soft-disable deceleration is announced only at its start, which TSR-624 accepts for that mild slow-down (DQ-407 A); its jerk is not bounded in the envelope (TSR-205, GAP-04) (O 5, D 4, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-001 open, SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-009 open, SFM-ACT-012 open. Fault trees: SG-04 BE-4.02, BE-4.06, BE-4.11 (single point), G4.1, G4.3. SFM-010 Insufficient deceleration for lead vehicle or stop (S 10; H-06). Effects: Deceleration request below what the situation needs / Closing distance to lead shrinks / Rear-end collision if the driver does not brake. Causes: SFM-010.C1 Lead missed due to radar/vision fusion fault (O 7, D 8, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-010.C2 Safety model minimum accel limit prevents required braking (by design) (O 6, D 10, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-010.C3 Brake system does not achieve requested deceleration (O 3, D 10, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-006 open, SFM-ACT-009 open, SFM-ACT-022 open. Fault trees: SG-06 BE-6.09, G6.9. SFM-011 Loss of longitudinal control without driver alert (S 10; H-06). Effects: Acceleration requests stop or are ignored while engaged / Vehicle coasts or holds previous state / Driver unaware; closing on lead. Causes: SFM-011.C1 Powertrain ignores requests without fault signal (O 3, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-011.C2 TX path to vehicle lost silently (O 5, D 10, M 6, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-011.C3 A non-finite aTarget zeroes the acceleration request without an event while ACC is shown engaged (controlsd.py:129-131; TSR-604 met in part, GAP-19) (O 5, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-012 open, SFM-ACT-018 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-02 BE-2.06; SG-06 UE-6.08, BE-2.06, G6.7. SFM-012 Late reaction to lead vehicle braking (S 10; H-06). Effects: Deceleration request delayed / Reduced time gap / Rear-end collision or harsh late braking. Causes: SFM-012.C1 Pipeline latency (CPU overload, thermal throttle, messaging delay) (O 6, D 10, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-012.C2 Lead state filtered too slowly (radard) (O 6, D 8, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-009 open, SFM-ACT-022 open. Fault trees: SG-06 BE-6.01, BE-6.09. SFM-037 Longitudinal command frozen at last value (S 10; H-03, H-06). Effects: Same acceleration request repeated regardless of lead, set speed or road / Vehicle holds a constant acceleration or deceleration request / Unintended acceleration when the frozen request is positive ; Insufficient deceleration when the lead brakes and the frozen request is not braking. Causes: SFM-037.C1 controlsd hangs while card keeps sending the last carControl (O 6, D 10, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-037.C2 plannerd stops or runs late while engaged, so controlsd keeps using the last longitudinalPlan (O 4, D 9, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-037.C3 Messaging delivers a stale longitudinal plan or command with fresh timestamps (O 5, D 10, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open, SFM-ACT-015 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.19; SG-03 BE-1.19; SG-06 BE-6.05.
